items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I think it was with Jerome Richardson. It was called “Roamin’ with Richardson” for Prestige.

ctx.x: You started working with a great list of fellas. Jerome Richardson, Mingus, Roy Haynes. Were these like one night things kind of? Pick up gigs?
Well first of all Jerome Richardson, I knew him in California.
That’s right, he came from there too.
